description: This file defines the ConfigManager class in Drupal, providing helper functions for managing configuration entities, dependencies, diffing configurations, and uninstalling configuration components.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Config\ConfigManager
classes.description: Provides helper functions for managing configuration entities, dependencies, diffing configurations, and uninstalling configuration components within Drupal.

methods.name: getEntityTypeIdByName
methods.description: Retrieves the entity type ID based on a configuration entity name.

methods.name: loadConfigEntityByName
methods.description: Loads a configuration entity by its name.

methods.name: getEntityTypeManager
methods.description: Returns the entity type manager service.

methods.name: diff
methods.description: Computes the difference between two configuration storages, returning a Diff object.

methods.name: createSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the current configuration storage.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls a configuration component, removing dependent entities and configuration data.

methods.name: getConfigDependencyManager
methods.description: Returns a ConfigDependencyManager instance representing configuration dependencies.

methods.name: findConfigEntityDependencies
methods.description: Finds configuration entity dependencies for given names.

methods.name: findConfigEntityDependenciesAsEntities
methods.description: Finds configuration entity dependencies and loads them as entity objects.

methods.name: getConfigEntitiesToChangeOnDependencyRemoval
methods.description: Determines which configuration entities need to be updated or deleted when dependencies are removed.

methods.name: callOnDependencyRemoval
methods.description: Calls an entity’s onDependencyRemoval() method with affected dependencies.

methods.name: findMissingContentDependencies
methods.description: Finds content dependencies that are missing (not loaded).
